user_story: As a user, I want the system to return an error when I try to get a task with a non-existent ID so that I know the task does not exist.

positive.title: Retrieve an existing task successfully
steps: Send a request to get a task with a valid existing ID.
Receive the response from the system.
positive.expected_result: The task details are returned successfully without error.

negative.title: Attempt to retrieve a task with a non-existent ID
steps: Send a request to get a task with a non-existent ID.
Receive the response from the system.
negative.expected_result: An error message is returned indicating that the task does not exist.

edge.title: Attempt to retrieve a task with an ID format that is invalid
steps: Send a request to get a task with an invalid format ID (e.g., a string or special characters).
Receive the response from the system.
edge.expected_result: An error message is returned indicating that the ID format is invalid.
